episodes.title: The Goddamn Brownies
episodes.summary: Home alone on maternity leave, Samira finds friendship with a ragtag group of quirky neighbors; when the abandoned Victorian across the street goes up for sale, their quiet suburban life is upended by the mysterious new neighbor who moves in.

episodes.title: Mind Your Own Business
episodes.summary: After witnessing suspicious behavior from her mysterious new neighbor Gary, Samira becomes convinced that he's hiding something; as she digs deeper in Hinkley Hills' past, she starts to suspect that he may be connected to an unsolved crime.

episodes.title: Sardine?
episodes.summary: Samira uses the disappearance of a neighbor's dog as a ruse to convince her new friends to break into the Victorian so she can confirm her suspicions about Gary; once inside, the group is shocked to find far more than they were looking for.

episodes.title: A Nine on the Tension Scale
episodes.summary: The annual block party brings big fun and bigger reveals; amidst the festivities, rumors swirl through town and Samira suspects that Rob is hiding something sinister; as she races to uncover the truth, her reality is called into question.

episodes.title: The Old Face-to-Face
episodes.summary: As glimpses of Rob and Naveen's past surface, Samira pieces together key clues and makes a startling realization about their strange neighbor across the street-one that unexpectedly turns everyone's worlds upside down.

episodes.title: Neighbor Take Warning
episodes.summary: The cul-de-sac crew goes on a mission to uncover the truth and save a neighbor whose life may be in danger… but the threat isn't what they expected, and what they discover could upend everything they thought they knew about their quiet suburban town.

episodes.title: Do Not Mess With Suburbanites
episodes.summary: Just when the cul-de-sac crew believes they've hit a dead end in their investigation, a dangerous threat suddenly lands directly on their doorstep, putting everyone on a terrifying and thrilling collision course with the truth.

episodes.title: Only One Way Out
episodes.summary: Samira follows her instincts and uncovers a sinister, long-buried town wide secret-one that threatens to destroy Hinkley Hills' image as "The Safest Town in America" and shake the community to its very core.
